_readme: Pastor/admin posts only: 공지 (notice), 주보 (bulletin), 행사 (event). No write form, login, comments, or member posting. Add objects to notices[]. Do not invent church news. Fields: category (notice|bulletin|event), date (YYYY-MM-DD), titleKo, titleEn, bodyKo, bodyEn. Optional: image or images[] (site-relative img/... jpg/png/webp/gif, with altKo/altEn), link (http/https only; Kakao only if the church provides a URL), linkLabelKo, linkLabelEn. Set sample to true only for how-to cards.
